result.title: TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
result.summary: Topological deep learning (TDL) extends learning on graphs, such as molecules or social networks, to higher-order structures, such as rings in a molecule or groups in a social network. Explaining which of these structures drive a model's predictions, and which architectural components matter most for its performance, remains challenging. We introduce TopoSHAP, an efficient and general explanation framework that addresses both questions across topological domains and model architectures. TopoSHAP-cell assigns Shapley values to topological data cells and extracts compact explanations. These explanations match or outperform graph-based counterparts on GraphXAI benchmark data while running up to 112$\times$ faster. They also reveal advantageous topological feature design, leading to measured improvements in explanation recovery and predictive accuracy. On the architecture side, TopoSHAP-neighbor explains how neighborhoods contribute to model performance, and turns these evaluations into a backward-elimination search that identifies smaller, competitive architectures early in training. This is up to $11.3\times$ cheaper than traditional TDL training sweeps.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TopoSHAP：用 Shapley 值给拓扑深度学习中的数据单元（如分子环、社交群体）分配贡献并抽取紧凑解释，另以 TopoSHAP-neighbor 评估邻域组件对性能的贡献，并据此做反向消除式架构搜索，在 GraphXAI 类基准上更快且解释恢复更好。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按单元/组件做 Shapley 贡献归因与基于归因的反向消除剪枝，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 步骤间的贡献分配提供可核查的度量思路，但原文并不涉及多模态推理状态。
